title: English Practice Quiz 0950
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A project milestone marks ___.
options: the colour of a project folder
questions.explanation: A milestone is a significant point in a project's progress.

questions.question: A project scope defines ___.
options: the work and boundaries of the project
the personal goals of every visitor
questions.explanation: Scope describes what is included and excluded from the project.

questions.question: A project timeline shows ___.
options: the cost of every office chair
questions.explanation: A timeline organises activities over time.

questions.question: A project risk is an uncertain event that may affect ___.
options: the colour of the company logo
questions.explanation: Risks can influence objectives such as time, cost or quality.

questions.question: A project owner is generally responsible for ___.
questions.explanation: The project owner provides direction and accountability for outcomes.

questions.question: A dependency means one task ___.
options: relies on another task or condition
has no connection to any work
is completed before it is assigned

questions.question: A project status report should communicate progress, issues and ___.
questions.explanation: Status reports help stakeholders understand progress and what happens next.

questions.question: A change request is used to formally propose ___.
options: a change to an agreed project element
the deletion of all project records
questions.explanation: A change request documents a proposed adjustment for review.

questions.question: A project deliverable is ___.
options: a specific output produced by the project
questions.explanation: A deliverable is a tangible or defined output of project work.

questions.question: A project retrospective is held to ___.
options: review what went well and what can improve
questions.explanation: A retrospective helps the team learn from the work completed.
